hero.eyebrow: Food-grade HDPE for the food industry
hero.subtitle: We robot-print food-grade HDPE directly onto your shaft or roller and mill the layer to size in the same cell. Up to Ø600 × 3500 mm, new or as a recoat, 3-week lead time.

tiles.envelope_body: Besides shafts and rollers, we print in one piece what others have to weld or segment.
tiles.process_title: The same robot mills the finish smooth.
tiles.process_body: No layer lines where you don't want them. Hybrid additive + subtractive in one cell.
tiles.materials_body: Polyolefins at this scale — our standard. Includes food-grade HDPE.
tiles.recyclate_body: Single-stream offcuts straight from Kuypers Kunststoftechniek. Traceable to batch.
tiles.layers_body: FGF pellet extrusion via robot arm. Fast, clean, scalable.

projects.body: Case studies from architectural elements to industrial parts.

cta_band.title: Got a part in mind? Send it over for a quote.

shafts.title: Worn roller? We recoat it, no mould needed.
shafts.body: Food-grade HDPE printed directly onto your shaft or roller and milled to size. Also for a single piece or a small series.
